summary: Five executed retail leases within 8 miles and dated 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 were selected and ranked by distance: Birch Square 1 (0.8 mi), Birch Grove 2 (1.03 mi, with executed amendment), Birch Grove 3 (1.26 mi), Birch Point 4 (1.49 mi, gross with expenses), and Birch Point 5 (1.72 mi). Effective net rent was computed per client convention: face converted to annual $/sf, 2.5% annual bumps applied at months 13/25/etc., free months at zero face, gross leases deducted $6.25/sf annually each month, TI subtracted once, then annualized. Two additional executed leases (Birch Park 6 at 1.95 mi and Birch Crossing 7 at 2.18 mi) were eligible but fell outside the top five by distance. An executed amendment for Birch Grove 2 (U-R3353-1) was applied; a later-dated amendment for Birch Grove 3 and an unsigned draft for Birch Point 4 were not applied per rules. A comp-grid XLSX with the selected five comps and citations was created: artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx.
limitations: Figures rely solely on the provided abstracts/updates; no external verification.
Undiscounted rent-only convention may differ from market appraisals; rounding may cause minor variances.
Duplicates were consolidated by entity_id; if latent differences exist between duplicate sources, they are not independently reconciled.
Later-dated or unpublished updates were excluded per cutoff rules, which could omit subsequent modifications.
